name: A Burlington street
blurb: A Burlington, Vermont street scene with maple trees, a lawn, and a city park: squirrels by day, birds at dawn and dusk, and raccoons after dark.

facts.text: Burlington, Vermont has a humid continental climate (Köppen Dfa) with cold, snowy winters and warm, humid summers.

facts.text: Lake Champlain, one of the largest freshwater lakes in the United States, lies between Vermont and New York adjacent to Burlington.

The nominal average January temperature in Burlington is about 21°F, and the nominal average July temperature is about 71°F.
